_comment: The catalog `ship` refreshes. Add this marketplace FROM THE REMOTE (claude plugin marketplace add <owner>/overnight-cos) once the remote exists: adding it from a local clone makes this same manifest resolve to that folder, and every update then returns 'already up to date' forever, which is correct and reaches nobody. Set `owner.name` to the person or organization who owns this plugin.
name: overnight-cos
description: An overnight chief of staff: a nightly sweep of your mail, Slack, Notion and calendars, replies drafted in your voice by morning, and one-tap decisions on your phone that teach it what matters. Never sends anything.
